title: Adversarial Detection for Pre-trained Classifiers via Lipschitz-Margin Analysis with Certification
abstract: arXiv:2610.15359v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep classifiers deployed in safety-critical services like autonomous-driving perception remain vulnerable to small adversarial perturbations. Certified $\ell_2$ defenses today face a costly trade-off: randomized smoothing (RS) requires hundreds of noisy queries per input, while Lipschitz networks (LN) constrain the architecture and sacrifice clean accuracy. We take a detection-oriented approach instead: rather than certifying that predictions are invariant inside an $\ell_2$ ball, we certify that adversarial inputs within an $\ell_2$ ball are \emph{detected} --- a guarantee aligned with security-critical deployments where missing an attack is costlier than flagging a clean input.   To realize this, we prove a Lipschitz-margin reduction from certified $\ell_2$ robustness to certified detection, which reduces the problem to handling a single Lipschitz constant $L$. translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.15359v1，公告类型：cross）：部署在自动驾驶感知等安全关键服务中的深度分类器仍然容易受到微小对抗扰动的攻击。当前的认证ℓ2防御面临一个高昂的权衡：随机平滑（RS）需要对每个输入进行数百次带噪声的查询，而Lipschitz网络（LN）则约束网络架构并牺牲干净样本的准确率。我们转而采取一种面向检测的方法：不去认证预测在ℓ2球内保持不变，而是认证ℓ2球内的对抗输入会被*检测出来*——这一保证更符合安全关键部署场景的需求，因为在这些场景中，漏检攻击的代价高于误报干净输入。为实现这一目标，我们证明了从认证ℓ2鲁棒性到认证检测的Lipschitz间隔归约，从而将问题简化为处理单一的Lipschitz常数L。我们引入了两个检测器家族：D_Adv，它估计……
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向检测的认证防御新范式，通过Lipschitz间隔分析将认证ℓ2鲁棒性问题归约为认证检测问题，无需约束或修改预训练分类器架构，即可从理论上保证ℓ2球内的对抗输入能被可靠检测出来。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a detection-oriented certified defense paradigm that reduces certified ℓ2 robustness to certified detection via Lipschitz-margin analysis, guaranteeing that adversarial inputs within an ℓ2 ball are reliably detected without constraining or modifying the pre-trained classifier's architecture.
